title: ⚡ Bolt: [performance improvement] optimize UI search filters using WeakMap and for...in loops
body:
💡 What: The optimization implemented
Replaced repeatedly evaluated `JSON.stringify()` in body search with a `WeakMap` cache and replaced `Object.entries()` inside header search with a `for...in` loop.

🎯 Why: The performance problem it solves
Inside the `filteredInteractions()` UI render loop, the repetitive allocations and O(N) operations cause serious performance bottleneck on rendering.

📊 Impact: Expected performance improvement
Reduces execution time for body searches substantially by skipping `JSON.stringify()` repeatedly.

🔬 Measurement: How to verify the improvement
Locally check filtering interactions responsiveness via the UI extensions.
head: bolt-perf-search
